study_name: EC-QPF source-aligned selection-operator audit with explicit completion choices

source_steps.locator: Sec III.A, Eq.(12), p24434; Algorithm1 step2.2, p24436

Original center from velocity/heading/step-size IMU pipeline is not uniquely defined by available equations.
Exact beta-to-scale relation, IterMax, scalar V convention, empty-subset policy and duplication allocation are not reported.

Source compares CMCR-PF/SR-PF on180step tracking; this audit uses20 independent one-step Gaussian updates per seed dataset.

comparators.name: ellipse_exact_fitness
comparators.operation: minimum-distance singleton; exact nonempty-subset optimum of Eq.(22)
comparators.proof: Mean of any nonempty subset distances >= minimum distance; exp is monotone in negative distance.

comparators.name: ellipse_systematic_fitness
comparators.operation: normalize singleton Eq.(22) fitness and systematic resample to500

comparators.name: full_systematic_likelihood
comparators.operation: Gaussian likelihood on entire input cloud; contextual reference only

cost_contract: All counts reported separately: fitness-vector evaluations, candidate-distance evaluations, likelihood evaluations, binary dimensions processed, runtime. Fitness evaluation is not a likelihood evaluation; no operation-equivalence/quantum acceleration claim.
ess_contract: Normalized-weight sampling ESS applies only to systematic comparators. ESS for binary source/greedy selection is not defined; subset count is not ESS.

tests.properties: probability range, same shared ellipse, selected identity, source fitness optimum bound

allowed_conclusion: Mechanism and computational counts of this completed selection module under specified synthetic inputs.
